_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Uyimdlali {player_id} kwi-Tic Tac Toe yeethu eMdlali ezintathu.
Isithombe sakho sithi '{symbol}'.
Uvula imizuzu yokwenza isithombe sakho kwenkqubo yama-5x5 ukwenzela uluhlu oluqaqa oluqaqa.
Oluhlu lunokwenzeka ngokwezintlobo, ngokwempu, nangokwezicaphelo.
Nikela umovo wakho ngendlela '[4]' ukumka iceli yenombolo 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomathi yokunyusa engekho semthethweni. Sebenzisa '[cell]' apho iseli ingu-0-{max_cell} .
invalid_move.out_of_range: Inombolo yeceli engahalali: {cell}. Ingakufuneka ibe phakathi kwama-0 na {max_cell}.
